type StartParams = {
  field: {
    command: { type: "string" }
    mode: { type: "enum" }
    attempts: { type: "number" }
    enabled: { type: "boolean" }
    topology: { type: "array" }
    error: { type: "string" }
  }
  value: {
    command: string
    mode: "idle" | "active"
    attempts: number
    enabled: boolean
    topology: number[]
    error: string | null
  }
  mass: {
    attempts: number
    profile: { id: string } | null
  }
  energy: {
    channel: BroadcastChannel
    socket: WebSocket
  }
  self: {
    atom: string
    meta: string
    path: string
  }
}

export default async function start({ mass, value }: StartParams) {
  return {
    profileId: mass.profile?.id ?? value.command,
    attempts: mass.attempts + 1,
  }
}
